svg.text: repeated sessions projected from a 3-state phase space · colour carries the 4th axis — success over time
SESSION STARTS — scattered initial conditions, then convergence
white comet = the live session · cyan echo = retrieval returning memory to action
READING THE BUNDLE — A STRANGE ATTRACTOR, DRAWN HONESTLY
TRAJECTORY = one session through phase space (context load × action frequency × memory depth), projected to 2D.
CONVERGENCE = the ecosystem's steady state: scattered starts end up circulating the same two lobes — execution and memory.
COLOUR = success-rate telemetry along the path — pink segments are transient/contested, green segments are consolidated.
COMET = the live session tracing the attractor; the echo = retrieval pulling memory back into action.
TIME IS THE FOURTH AXIS: colour is a time-series along each line — failures fall away, survivors consolidate.
deterministic dynamics, never the same session twice — always the same two lobes: execution and memory
